entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Rajeev Shrivastava - Advocate for the petitioner
 Ms. Vrinda Dixit, Advocate for the respondent.

Order 
The present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is preferred by the petitioner seeking following reliefs:
(i) That, the respondent be directed not to interfere or to create any obstruction upon the land in question bearing survey No.848 situated in Village-Mau, Patwari,Halka Jalalpur, District Gwalior adjoining to the public road.
(ii) That, respondent further be directed if they needs the petitioner land for any purpose so they first show their intention and to followed the provision which is being provided under the provision of land Acquisition Act and to pay the compensation to petitioner before interfering in the possession of the petitioner land in question.
(iii) That, the cost of the litigation may also be awarded.
(iv) Any other relief which this Hon'ble Court deem fit in the facts and circumstances of the case may kindly be granted to the petitioner.

At the outset, with respect to the grievance of the petitioner, learned counsel for the petitioner prays that petitioner intends to prefer a fresh representation before the respondent-Gwalior Development Authority and direction may be issued to respondent-Gwalior Development Authority NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:8088 2 WP-10598-2021 to decide the same and if such directions are issued, the grievance of the petitioner would be redressed.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the respondent has vehemently opposed the prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and prays for dismissal of the petition.

4. Considering the submissions, without adverting on the merit of the case, this petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to submit fresh representation to the respondent-Gwalior Development Authority within a period of two weeks from today and on receipt of said representation, respondent-Gwalior Development Authority is directed to decide the representation of the petitioner as per law as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of eight weeks thereafter.
5.
With the aforesaid direction, this petition stands disposed of.
